The story shows originality in its format and genre hybridity by blending the conventions of a dramatic script with traditional prose. It relies almost entirely on sparse, rapid-fire dialogue interspersed with bracketed stage directions (e.g., "[Er nimmt die Jacke, setzt sich.]") to describe physical actions and setting, yet it occasionally retains traditional prose dialogue tags (e.g., "„Ohne Zucker?“, fragt Mara."). This unconventional, hybrid format strips away internal monologue and exposition, forcing the reader to infer the complex emotional history between the characters entirely through subtext and minor physical gestures.
